introHtml: Safety badge ID holders are designed with high-visibility colors like neon yellow or orange, making them ideal for construction sites, warehouses, and event security. Unlike standard clear holders, these add a layer of identification that helps spot personnel quickly. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or pad printing to keep your brand visible while prioritizing safety. Bulk orders ensure consistent color across your team.
heroAltText: Custom safety badge ID holders in bright neon colors for high visibility, displayed with a printed logo and clip attachment.
